# @three-ws/alerts-mcp

> Manage your three.ws pump.fun alert rules from any AI agent — create, update, and delete monitoring rules with in-app, webhook, and Telegram delivery, and read the fired-alert history. Account-scoped over the live API.

@three-ws/alerts-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/alerts-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/alerts-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/alerts-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/alerts-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/alerts-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
